top_signals.title: Oil rises amid growing Mideast tensions between Iran-backed Houthis and Saudi Arabia
top_signals.summary: Worries over supply disruptions due to escalating tensions in the Middle East helped to push oil prices higher.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Botswana Tapped as Southern African Hub for Dangote Refinery IPO
top_signals.summary: Botswana got selected as the host venue for the southern African portion of the initial public offering of the continent’s largest oil refinery, giving the relatively small market a key role in the region’s biggest listing to date.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Commodity repricing impacting inflation expectations and industrial supply chains.

top_signals.title: Most tokenized stock trading on Solana, BNB Chain occurs outside US market hours
top_signals.summary: Tokenized equities have reached nearly $3.3 billion in value as investors embrace round-the-clock access beyond Wall Street hours.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Digital asset volatility and institutional crypto positioning changes.

top_signals.title: L’Oréal’s Strategy for a New Era of Beauty
top_signals.summary: Raja Rajamannar sits down with Asmita Dubey, L'Oréal's global chief digital and marketing officer, to unpack how the century-old brand is adapting to the influencer economy and beauty technology.  (Source: Bloomberg)

top_signals.title: Hong Kong IPO Red Flags Include Sudden Loans, Secret Handshakes
top_signals.summary: Hong Kong’s markets watchdog has stepped up scrutiny of initial public offerings in one of the broadest enforcement actions in the city’s history, signaling a new level of concern about some practices in the booming market.
